blindSummary:
This state/province - the country's capital region - compresses the best and the worst of the country into one administrative area. One of its communes approved the country's first municipal anti-discrimination ordinance explicitly prohibiting hate speech, obliging non-discrimination clauses in municipal tenders and contracts, creating a communal seal for good practice and requiring anti-exclusion notices in municipal buildings - a genuinely first-in-country institutional protection for a visitor in that commune. A second commune's mayor declined to raise the LGBT pride flag on 17 May after councillors of the main right-wing party rebelled, despite an earlier commitment to the country's largest LGBT rights organisation. The internal spread between the state/province's most contrasting communes is larger than most states/provinces' entire deviation from the country-wide level.

The state/province held 25.12 % of national cases in 2024 (a close second to the highest-volume state/province), but as the country's most populous state/province this share is roughly proportional. In 2025 it was one of only two states/provinces where recorded cases fell. It carries the strongest institutional depth in the country: the country's top courts sit here, with the largest civil-society infrastructure, the greatest concentration of trans and non-binary community resources, and the highest density of legal aid and complaint mechanisms available to a visitor who encounters discrimination.

Local risk sits marginally above the country-wide level - the only above-average state/province in the set. The pioneer communal ordinance and the falling case count nudge the state/province up; the flag affair and the quarter-share of national cases pull the other way but are offset by proportional population. The much wider gap to the highest-volume state/province reflects that this one, despite carrying a quarter of national cases, has the institutional machinery to respond, while that state/province's problem is incident density without equivalent counterweight.
